confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, not based on live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than summer hotel rates, which vary widely with demand and events. The FX observation comes from a web search summary of the RBA exchange rates page; I could not independently confirm the figure on the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Vancouver price levels, benchmarked against other high-cost North American west-coast cities such as Seattle and Portland, and adjusted for the Canadian dollar.
